method: Sources opened with fetch_page or read from the repository in this pass. Fields not stated by the opened source are left unchanged. Retailer and aggregator copies are never recorded as MANUFACTURER_VERIFIED.

entries.evidence: The re-fetched French datasheet prints 86 rows: 2400 Hz (93.5 dB) and 2600 Hz (94 dB) are present, 2500 Hz is absent, and nine values differ from the stored 85-point table (140, 280, 300, 330, 400, 1200, 1400, 2000, 2200 Hz). The -3 dB range is printed as 77 Hz-16 kHz and -10 dB as 52 Hz-19 kHz, as before.

20 kHz: 61 dB (Amplitude & Phase table) vs 92 dB fundamental (Acoustic Contribution table) in the same manual. The 27 remaining points end at 10 kHz; the simulator extrapolated above the last point, so the series is excluded from simulation until the owner decides.

Appendix B: 'Frequency Response (-3 dB) 70 Hz – 20 kHz [CR3]'; 'Rated Power 28 watts rms 50 watts peak' (amplifier); 'Low Frequency 3.0 in / 76 mm polypropylene-coated woofer [CR3]'. The host is pdf-manuals.com, not Mackie; the Mackie page was not reached.

'Coaxial Designed 5.25? Diameter Polypropylene Woofer'; 'Frequency Response: 53Hz - 20kHz (+ or - 3dB)'; '100 Watts of Power (2 x 50w RMS)'. Retailer copy of the exact product; no Equator page reached. Sensitivity (103 dB SPL, no reference) stays unpopulated.
The sheet states 77 Hz-16 kHz (-3 dB) and 52 Hz-19 kHz (-10 dB). The stored table's own -3/-10 dB crossings still differ (see the 2026-10-12 notes); the averaging band is not stated.

The Zenodo record (Sound-source directivity dataset for four loudspeakers, Aalto University) lists LS_directivity_Calibrated_GENELEC_8331A.sofa, 410.5 MB, md5:a00e40164556183420c315e9f6ecd7fd, which matches the expected hash. The sandbox can reach only github.com, codeload.github.com, api.github.com, registry.npmjs.org, pypi.org and files.pythonhosted.org, so the file cannot be downloaded or hashed here.
